changelog:
Initial release of the "competitors" skill for structured competitor and alternative page creation:

- Provides expert guidelines for building competitor comparison and alternative pages aimed at SEO and sales enablement.
- Defines four core comparison formats: singular alternative, plural alternatives, you vs competitor, and competitor vs competitor.
- Outlines detailed page structures, research processes, and principles for honest, high-performing content.
- Emphasizes modular content architecture and centralized competitor data for easy updates and consistency.
- Includes actionable SEO best practices, keyword targets, internal linking strategies, and schema recommendations.
summary: When the user wants to create competitor comparison or alternative pages for SEO and sales enablement. Also use when the user mentions 'alternative page,' 'vs page,' 'competitor comparison,' 'comparison page,' '[Product] vs [Product],' '[Product] alternative,' 'competitive landing pages,' 'how do we compare to X,' 'battle card,' or 'competitor teardown.' Use this for any content that positions your product against competitors. Covers four formats: singular alternative, plural alternatives, you vs competitor, and competitor vs competitor. For sales-specific competitor docs, see sales-enablement.
